note: Curated Bitcoin-holdings ledger for The Librarian's Ledger's Treasuries board — our own version of bitbo.io/treasuries, not a mirror of it. This is a TOP-HOLDERS list, GROWING toward exhaustive rather than starting there. Each entity carries its OWN `as_of` where its figure has been individually checked against a real source (see `source_note`) — those without one inherit this file's own top-level `as_of` and should be read as rougher estimates, not verified. `public` and `mining` are ported from mstr-trader's own SEC-filing-curated btc_treasuries.json (2026-06-27 vintage) plus well-known additions; the 11 US spot-ETF rows and Strategy's own figure were individually verified against bitcointreasuries.net/The Block/issuer disclosures on 2026-09-06 — everything else (`country`, `private`, `defi`, and the smaller/international `etf` rows) has no filings to check and is still a Claude-researched estimate from general public reporting. Treat any unverified figure as approximate and due for refresh, exactly like every other curated figure in this repo (see build_finance.py's GOLD_TONNES/SILVER_TONNES comments for the same posture). Seized-government holdings are especially soft: amounts are frequently disputed, partly unconfirmed, and subject to ongoing legal disposal. Deliberately excluded rather than guessed at: politically fraught sanctions-evasion claims (e.g. Russia, Venezuela, Iran) too disputed to state as fact, and holders that have since fully divested (e.g. Germany's 2024 sale of its ~50,000 BTC seizure) — a zero-row would be clutter, not information. Every entry a reader flags via the Ask form (see ask.html) gets checked and folded in on the next update — that is the intended path to real exhaustiveness here, not a one-shot research pass. Nothing here is investment advice.
